scope: Keep the checked-in MJobs development entrypoints scoped to project-local dependencies and containers, and prevent common workstation-wide updates, driver/firmware/TDR/network changes, shutdowns, and broad process termination from entering those entrypoints.

validation.target: Safe project setup fixture and rejection of broad package upgrades, driver/network changes, reboot/process termination and unsafe package scripts
validation.summary: Five deterministic fixture tests passed. The initial RED run failed because the validator module did not yet exist.

validation.target: Checked-in PowerShell, shell, batch and package-script development entrypoints
validation.summary: No prohibited workstation-wide operations were detected; output contains only stable codes and repository paths.

validation.command: npm audit --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --prefix apps/web; npm ci --prefix apps/web; npm audit --prefix apps/web; npm audit --omit=dev --prefix apps/web
validation.target: Pin the single vulnerable transitive source-map-js development dependency and validate installed dependency tree
validation.summary: Updated source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 only. Full and production npm audits report zero vulnerabilities. npm emitted an engine warning because local Node 25.9.0 is outside the project's declared Node 22/24 support range.

validation.command: npm run build --prefix apps/web; npm test --prefix apps/web -- --run
validation.target: Frontend TypeScript/Vite production build and web regression tests after the lockfile patch
validation.summary: Build passed and all 62 frontend tests passed.

validation.target: Full Python/unit/integration/browser suite on source commit 6105f8cc99c3978919b945f0b9e0bf66dbeac7ad and tree b88a8e0293f836bce91cc562fcb82ead0226b2e9
validation.summary: 701 tests ran with one optional PostgreSQL skip. All product and browser assertions passed except the existing CompanyDiscoveryRequestsBrowserTests Uvicorn server-thread shutdown assertion. That exact case passed alone in 2.9 seconds and all 36 browser tests passed on the same tree; no timeout was weakened.

validation.target: Isolate the sole full-suite failure and verify complete headless browser suite after the dependency update
validation.summary: Flaky shutdown case passed alone in 2.9 seconds; all 36 headless Chromium browser tests passed. External browser requests remained blocked by the test fixtures.

validation.command: python -m tools.verification.agent_skills; python -m tools.verification.catalogue; python -m tools.verification.progress validate; git diff --check
validation.target: Repository skill, unchanged requirement/reference denominator, progress journal and whitespace validation
validation.summary: All validators passed; denominators remain 366 requirements and 59 reference gaps.

requirement_limitations: The deterministic checker protects checked-in setup scripts and package scripts against listed common operations; it cannot control manual commands or arbitrary obfuscation outside those entrypoints.
The full suite had one pre-existing timing-sensitive Uvicorn shutdown assertion; the case passed alone and the entire browser suite passed on the same candidate.
